groups.name: Elective(s)
groups.note: MATH Mathematics Electives: courses from the specified elective list, of which at least 6 credits must be at 3000-level or above; and out of these 6 credits at 3000-level or above, at least 3 credits must be at 4000-level or above. The eligible pool is: MATH courses at 1000- and 2000-level (except courses coded from 1000 to 1600) AND MATH courses at 3000-level or above. The PDF provides no fixed course list (open-ended); the courses array is empty.
